name: trousev-skillset
description: A curated marketplace of Claude Code plugins and skills — product planning, architecture, and developer productivity.

plugins.name: product-planning
plugins.description: Interactive 4-step feature planning interview: Product Questions → Technical Implementation → Implementation Details → Attack & Challenge. Outputs a complete feature spec.

plugins.name: deepseek-fix
plugins.description: Fixes Claude Code security classifier hanging when using DeepSeek API. Local stdlib Python proxy injects thinking:disabled into non-streaming requests, dropping classifier latency from ~32s to ~3s.

plugins.name: stack
plugins.description: Instructs the AI to deliver work as a stack of small, verified, CI-green PRs — one task per PR, each stacked on the previous one. Supports --merge for already-merged base PRs.

plugins.name: deepseek-vision
plugins.description: Brings vision and image generation to DeepSeek-powered Claude Code sessions via OpenAI — /vision for GPT-4o image analysis with research-backed web design critique, /generate for DALL-E 3 image creation.
